# GWS Gmail Reply-All

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — one subcommand of the gws CLI: reply-all to a Gmail message, answering the sender and all original To/CC recipients while keeping the thread intact. Distinct from the already-listed googleworkspace-gws-gmail-reply — that one replies to the sender only; this one manages multi-recipient threading, with flags to add recipients (--to/--cc/--bcc), exclude people (--remove), send HTML (--html), attach files, save as draft (--draft), or preview the request (--dry-run). Requires the gws CLI and a paid Google Workspace account — there is no free tier for this CLI. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: gws-shared must be read first for auth and global flags; the command fails if no To recipient remains after exclusions; the skill documents the command — it doesn't set up your Google Cloud auth for you. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
